name: tapetide
description: Indian stock market research for about 8,000 NSE and BSE listed companies: latest quotes, quarterly and annual financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio fundamental screener, technical screens, analyst estimates, FII/DII flows, end-of-day index option chains with IV, parsed company filings, IPOs, and your Tapetide portfolio and watchlist. 48 tools (55 including aliases). Free plan included. Research data, not investment advice.

TAPETIDE_TOKEN.description: Free personal access token from https://tapetide.com/settings/tokens

tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find an Indian stock's symbol by company name, brand name, symbol, BSE code or ISIN, with optional sector and industry filters.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get a company overview: sector, business summary, pros and cons, key fundamentals (PE, PB, ROE, ROCE, debt/equity), growth metrics and current quote.

tools.name: get_stock_events
tools.description: Get a stock's news, corporate actions (dividends, splits, bonuses, AGMs) or company filings.

tools.name: get_stock_ownership
tools.description: Get a stock's dividend history with yields and the mutual fund schemes that hold it.

tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Get the latest price quote for a stock: last traded price, change, volume, market cap, PE, PB and 52-week high and low.

tools.name: get_batch_quotes
tools.description: Get the latest price quotes for up to 20 stocks in one call.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get daily or weekly OHLCV price history for a stock with delivery percentage, one row per session.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get quarterly and annual P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and ratios for one company, each period stamped with its publication date.

tools.name: get_shareholding
tools.description: Get a stock's shareholding pattern quarter by quarter: promoter, FII, DII and public holdings.

tools.name: get_forecasts
tools.description: Get analyst estimates for EPS, revenue, EBITDA, net income, ROA and ROE against reported actuals.

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: Get a daily market snapshot: FII/DII net flows in crores, Nifty 50 valuations (PE, PB, dividend yield) and the India VIX.

tools.name: get_fii_dii_detail
tools.description: Get detailed FII/DII flows: 30 days of daily cash-market flows, F&O participant positions, period aggregates, streaks and cumulative net flows.

tools.name: get_fii_dii_flows
tools.description: Alias of get_fii_dii_detail; returns the same detailed FII/DII flow data.

tools.name: get_fpi_sectors
tools.description: Get Foreign Portfolio Investor (FPI) investment by sector: AUM share, fortnightly change and one-year cumulative flow.

tools.name: get_market_news
tools.description: Get the latest market-wide news across categories, with sentiment and related symbols.

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Get one of seven daily market-wide feeds by dataset: bulk and block deals, F&O ban list, deliveries, IPOs, MTF, SLBM or signals.

tools.name: market_valuations
tools.description: Get index valuation metrics (PE, PB and dividend yield) over time, up to 20 years.

tools.name: market_heatmap
tools.description: Get every constituent of one of 16 indices with market cap, PE, PB, returns from 1 day to 5 years, volume and sector.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Screen Indian stocks on 326 fundamental ratios (valuation, profitability, growth, balance sheet, cash flow, shareholding) using plain-English queries.

tools.name: screen_stocks_technical
tools.description: Screen Indian stocks on technical indicators such as RSI, MACD, moving-average crossovers, Bollinger Bands, ADX, volume and momentum.

tools.name: get_screener_ratios
tools.description: Search or list the 326 financial ratios available to screen_stocks to get exact ratio names for a query.

tools.name: get_trending_stocks
tools.description: Get the day's top gainers, top losers and most-active stocks from the Nifty 500.

tools.name: get_options_analytics
tools.description: Get the latest per-expiry options analytics for a stock: ATM IV, IV rank and percentile, realised volatility, put-call ratio, max pain and skew.

tools.name: get_stock_deals
tools.description: Get a stock's bulk deals, block deals, insider trades and SAST disclosures, with counterparty, side, quantity and value.

tools.name: get_promoter_pledge
tools.description: Get a stock's promoter share-pledge percentage over recent quarters plus recent pledge creation and release events.

tools.name: get_credit_ratings
tools.description: Get a company's credit-rating actions over time: agency, rating, action (upgrade, downgrade or reaffirm) and outlook.

tools.name: get_earnings_call_summary
tools.description: Get structured digests of a company's recent earnings-call transcripts and investor presentations: highlights, risks, guidance and key metrics.

tools.name: get_india_vix
tools.description: Get the India VIX, a gauge of expected near-term market volatility: latest level, daily change and recent history.

tools.name: list_company_documents
tools.description: List a company's parsed filings (concall transcripts, annual reports, presentations, IPO documents) with doc_id, type, period, page count and links.

tools.name: get_document_summary
tools.description: Get an investor digest of one parsed filing: summary, highlights, risks, guidance and key metrics, with links to the PDF and full Markdown.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read the Markdown text of a parsed filing by doc_id and page range, with page markers for citing.

tools.name: get_tapetide_score
tools.description: Get the Tapetide Score for one stock: a deterministic 0-100 composite rating with six pillar sub-scores, band, percentile and data confidence.

tools.name: screen_tapetide_scores
tools.description: Rank and filter stocks by Tapetide Score using size bucket, band, score window, sector, minimum data confidence and symbol or name search.

tools.name: get_option_chain
tools.description: Get an end-of-day index option chain by strike with implied volatility, Greeks, bid/ask, open interest, max pain and put-call ratio.

tools.name: get_option_iv_history
tools.description: Get the session-by-session options analytics history for an underlying: ATM IV, IV rank and percentile, realised volatility, put-call ratio and skew.

tools.name: get_index_performance
tools.description: Rank about 140 NSE indices by return over recent completed weeks or months, using official NSE closing levels.

tools.name: get_index_history
tools.description: Get the historical OHLC level series with PE, PB and dividend yield for a single NSE index, such as Nifty 50, Nifty Bank or India VIX.

tools.name: get_adjustment_factors
tools.description: Get a stock's split and bonus adjustment-factor timeline so a raw price series can be rebuilt from the adjusted one.

tools.name: get_observation_status
tools.description: Get, for each calendar day in a window, why a stock's price is present or missing: traded, weekend, holiday, pre-listing, delisted or no print.

tools.name: get_index_membership_asof
tools.description: Check whether a stock was in an index on a past date, answered as present, uncertain, absent or out of coverage.

tools.name: resolve_identifier_asof
tools.description: Resolve a historical symbol or ISIN to the company that held it on a given date.

tools.name: get_identifiers_asof
tools.description: Get the symbol and ISIN a company traded under on a given date; the reverse of resolve_identifier_asof.

tools.name: read_me
tools.description: Get the usage guide for this server: every tool by category, data conventions, the disclaimer rule and patterns for combining calls.

tools.name: scan_movers
tools.description: Alias of get_trending_stocks; returns the day's top gainers, losers and most-active Nifty 500 stocks.

tools.name: get_live_quote
tools.description: Alias of get_stock_quote; returns the latest price quote for a stock.

tools.name: get_stock_news
tools.description: Alias of get_stock_events with type "news"; returns recent news for a stock.

tools.name: get_corporate_actions
tools.description: Alias of get_stock_events with type "corporate_actions"; returns a stock's dividends, splits, bonuses and AGMs.

tools.name: run_preset_screen
tools.description: Redirect that points a preset-screen request to get_trending_stocks, screen_stocks or screen_stocks_technical, which answer it.

tools.name: get_user_portfolio
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Tapetide portfolio with latest prices, P&L, invested value, weight, sector and market-cap class.

tools.name: add_portfolio_stocks
tools.description: Add one or more holdings to the user's Tapetide portfolio, merging duplicates on a weighted-average price.

tools.name: update_portfolio_stock
tools.description: Update the quantity and average price of an existing holding in the user's Tapetide portfolio.

tools.name: remove_portfolio_stocks
tools.description: Remove one or more holdings from the user's Tapetide portfolio.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description: Get every stock on the user's Tapetide watchlist, with sector and industry.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add one or more stocks to the user's Tapetide watchlist.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove one or more stocks from the user's Tapetide watchlist.

npm.description: Run the published npm package over stdio

uvx.description: Run the published Python package over stdio

examples.description: Fundamentals and price context for one stock
examples.prompt: Give me a snapshot of RELIANCE: latest quote, last 4 quarters of revenue and profit, and promoter holding trend.

examples.title: Screen for quality
examples.prompt: Find NSE stocks with ROCE above 20%, debt to equity below 0.5 and market cap above 5,000 crore.

examples.title: Institutional flows
examples.prompt: Summarise FII and DII cash market flows for the last 10 trading days.
